after: This registry covers the six gate-facing unions. A verb-local refusal union outside them is still bound by invariant 6: it is exported, frozen, and pinned by a test in the verb's own suite. (Amended APRV-215.) It also covers `channel_decision_refusal_codes`, which is not gate-facing and is registered here anyway: the refusals a decision surface makes are answers a human reads on their phone, and a vocabulary a second implementation has to guess at is exactly what this registry exists to stop. (Amended APRV-324.)
